title: Progenitor cell isolation from mouse epididymal adipose tissue and sequencing library construction
protocol: Sacrifice the mouse using an approved protocol.
Spray 70% ethanol over the mouse for sterilization and to minimize contamination.
Dissect the skin and make an incision across the abdominal muscle with forceps and scissors.
Use forceps to hold the eVAT, slightly pull it up, and adjust the position to expose the entire eVAT pad, testis, and ductus deferens.
Dissect the eVAT together with the testis and epididymis while avoiding the ductus deferens.
Carefully rinse the eVAT in PBS to remove as much blood as possible.
Transfer the eVAT into a pre-chilled 2 mL centrifuge tube and add 500 μL digestion buffer.
Mince the eVAT with scissors into ∼1 mm3 pieces and keep the tube on ice until all samples are processed.
Add more digestion buffer.
Transfer the suspension to a 5 mL or 14 mL Falcon tube as needed.
Ensure the volume of the suspension is between 40% and 60% of the tube capacity.
Place the centrifuge tube horizontally in a pre-heated shaking incubator at 37°C, 150 rpm for 10–15 minutes.
Seal the cap with parafilm to prevent potential leakage.
Mount the tube firmly in the shaking incubator with tape.
Remove the tube from the incubator after shaking.
Shake the tube briefly or use a wide-bore pipette tip to pipet the suspension 10 times.
If adipocytes are desired, allow the cell suspension to stand on the benchtop for 1 minute.
Transfer the upper adipocyte layer to a 1.5 mL tube with a wide-bore pipette tip for further processing.
Transfer the suspension to a pre-chilled 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 10–20 mL ice-cold PBS to stop the digestion.
Filter the cell suspension with a 100 μm cell strainer.
Filter the filtered suspension with a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the filtered cell suspension at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the upper lipid layer and supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL red blood cell lysis buffer on ice for 1 min.
Add 10–20 mL ice-cold PBS, then centrifuge at 600 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 μL ice-cold sorting buffer containing 0.5 μL fluorophore-conjugated antibodies (e.g., BV421-anti-Icam1, APC-anti-Dpp4, and PE/Cy7-anti-CD45).
Transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Incubate in the dark for 20 min at 4°C.
Add 1 mL ice-cold PBS.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ice-cold sorting buffer.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL ice-cold sorting buffer.
Check the cell density under a microscope before proceeding to FACS.
Perform FACS to sort out the desired cell population.
Centrifuge the sorted cells at 1,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Use a pipet to remove the last 100 μL supernatant from cell pellet.
Add 8.5 μL ice-cold 1× lysis buffer and pipette 10–20 times to fully resuspend the cell pellet.
Incubate the lysate on ice for 20 min to disrupt the cell membrane.
Add 12.5 μL 2× Tris-DMF tagmentation buffer and 2 μL Nextera Tn5 transposase (TDE1) to the lysate.
Pipette to fully mix.
Incubate in a pre-heated ThermoMixer C at 700 rpm and 37°C for 30 min.
Add 0.5 μL 10% SDS, pipette to mix well, and incubate on ice for 5 min to stop the tagmentation reaction.
Purify the tagmented DNA fragments using the QIAGEN MinElute Reaction Cleanup Kit following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Run PCR in a thermocycler according to the specified settings.
Incubate amplified DNA fragments on ice for up to 24 hours or store them at -20°C for one week.
Add 55 μl (1.1×) AMPure XP beads to the amplified DNA fragments and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Incubate the tube on the bench top for 5 minutes.
Place the tube on a magnetic stand until the liquid phase becomes clear.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the bead pellet.
Gently add 200 μl freshly made 80% ethanol to wash the beads and incubate for 30 seconds.
Remove ethanol and repeat washing steps twice in total with 80% ethanol.
Carefully remove residual ethanol using a pipette.
Air dry the bead pellet with the tube open on a magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes without over-drying.
Elute DNA from beads by adding 25 μl TE buffer or nuclease-free H2O and mix gently.
Incubate on bench top for 3 min.
Place the tube back on the magnetic stand for 5 min or until the liquid phase becomes clear.
Carefully transfer 23 μL supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.
Analyze the DNA concentration and the size distribution with an Agilent TapeStation or a Bioanalyzer.
Note: The DNA library can be further sequenced or stored at −80°C for up to 12 months.
